title: iQOO Neo 11 Ultra Launches in China With 9,000mAh Battery and Custom Dimensity 9500
excerpt: The gaming-focused smartphone brings a massive battery, 2K OLED display, and a tuned MediaTek chipset, but is unlikely to reach India this year.
body:
• iQOO launched the Neo 11 Ultra in China on August 10 with a customized MediaTek Dimensity 9500 chipset tuned for sustained performance over peak speeds.
  • The phone packs a 9,000mAh battery with 100W wired charging, a 6.83-inch flat 2K OLED display, and IP68/IP69 water resistance.
  • RAM options include 12GB and 16GB with up to 512GB storage, starting at approximately CNY 3,000 (roughly ₹42,000).
  • iQOO reportedly has no plans to bring the Neo series to India in 2026, focusing instead on its flagship lineup.

What the Neo 11 Ultra Offers

iQOO has officially launched the Neo 11 Ultra in China, delivering a spec sheet that punches well above its price class. The phone runs a customized version of MediaTek's Dimensity 9500 chipset — built on a 3nm process — with clock speeds slightly dialed back from the stock chip. The move trades marginal benchmark points for better sustained performance and power efficiency, a calculation that makes sense for a device targeting extended gaming sessions.

https://x.com/91mobiles/status/2088166230280794390

The octa-core processor features four efficiency cores clocked at 2.7GHz, three performance cores at 3.5GHz, and a prime core peaking at 4.21GHz. Geekbench listings under model number V2545A showed scores of 3,395 (single-core) and 10,312 (multi-core) — solid numbers for the mid-range segment.

Display and Battery

The Neo 11 Ultra sports a 6.83-inch flat 2K OLED panel that, according to tipster Digital Chat Station, uses a new domestic display manufacturing process. iQOO claims it is the only phone in its price segment pairing a 2K screen with the Dimensity 9500 — a combination typically reserved for costlier flagships.

The battery is the headline figure: 9,000mAh, a significant leap from the Neo 11's 7,500mAh cell. Charging tops out at 100W wired, with no wireless charging support. A 3D ultrasonic fingerprint scanner replaces the optical sensor found in many competitors, and the phone carries both IP68 and IP69 water and dust resistance ratings.

Software and Storage

The handset ships with Vivo's OriginOS 6 layered over Android 16. Storage configurations span 12GB + 256GB, 12GB + 512GB, 16GB + 256GB, and 16GB + 512GB of LPDDR5X RAM and UFS 4.1 storage. Color options — Light White, Shadow Black, and Wind Chaser — signal a broader consumer pitch beyond iQOO's traditional gaming audience.

India Availability Looks Unlikely

Despite the competitive specifications, iQOO is reportedly not planning to bring any Neo series phones to India in 2026, according to a GSMArena report. The company is said to be refining its portfolio strategy amid rising component costs, choosing to focus its India efforts on flagship products instead. The last Neo device to launch in India was the Neo 10 in May 2025.

For Indian consumers watching this segment, the Neo 11 Ultra's feature set — particularly its battery capacity and display quality — sets a benchmark that rival brands will need to match in the sub-₹45,000 bracket.

What's Next

With the Neo 11 Ultra now official, attention turns to whether iQOO will follow up with additional variants or bring elements of this hardware to its India-bound lineup under a different brand. The Dimensity 9500-powered mid-range space is getting crowded in China, with Redmi's K90 Ultra and K90 Max competing directly. How iQOO prices the Neo 11 Ultra against these alternatives will determine whether its spec-sheet advantages translate into market share.
nri_angle: While the Neo 11 Ultra is China-only, its specs set benchmarks for the Indian sub-₹45,000 smartphone market where iQOO competes actively.
